text: If a predicate has more than one variable, each variable must be bound by a separate quantifier. A logical expression with more than one quantifier that binds different variables in the same predicate is said to have nested quantifiers. The examples below show several logical expressions and which variables are bound in each. The logical expression is a proposition if all the variables are bound.
